Homelab

This is the homelab in numbers. A small collector reads the cluster's own monitoring and the repository, signs what it found and hands it to this page every minute. The page itself has no access to anything, which is rather the point.

Why is the availability always for yesterday? A live status page would tell anyone watching when the house is down, and a power cut is precisely when you'd rather nobody knew. A finished day says nothing of the sort.

Not every app is here. The download tooling is left out on purpose (sorry, nothing to see there).

No figures yet: the collector has not pushed any.

Solar production Coming later

What the solar panels produce over the day. Production only: what the house consumes stays private, as it says far too much about when we are home.

Home automation Coming later

A few figures from Home Assistant, once I have worked out which ones are both interesting and safe to share. Nothing that tells you whether anybody is in.
